ISSUE #758: [ FastAPI ] Add OAuth2 token refresh support to security module

DESCRIPTION:
The OAuth2PasswordBearer in `fastapi/fastapi/security/oauth2.py` does not support token refresh flow out of the box.

### Implementation

- Add a new class `OAuth2PasswordBearerWithRefresh` in `fastapi/fastapi/security/oauth2.py` that extends OAuth2PasswordBearer
- The new class should accept an additional `refresh_url` parameter for the token refresh endpoint
- Add `OAuth2RefreshRequestForm` class similar to OAuth2PasswordRequestForm but accepting grant_type=refresh_token and a refresh_token field
- Export the new classes from `fastapi/fastapi/__init__.py`

### Acceptance Criteria

- OAuth2PasswordBearerWithRefresh class works as a drop-in replacement for OAuth2PasswordBearer
- The refresh_url appears in the OpenAPI schema under the OAuth2 security scheme
- OAuth2RefreshRequestForm validates that grant_type is refresh_token
- Existing OAuth2PasswordBearer behavior is not modified
- Tests cover both the standard flow and refresh flow
